reviewed_numeric_changes.rationale: R72: Recover authentic frozen late outcomes exactly once without changing/replaying the newer VM head. Chronological update formula and DEV training implementation unchanged; verified late/duplicate/next-label regression. No inherited certificate authority.
R71: Old but well-formed HTTP payload remains rejected and triggers failover, while not tripping transport outage backoff. Real transport/schema failures still trip the circuit.
R72: Settle valid late frozen labels without rewinding state; chronological VM update unchanged. Verified both ordering directions and repeated calls; no certificate created.

R70: Move Android memory-callback persistence onto the existing guard handler; bounded retention retries, independent quiet reclaim and one coalesced research continuation on the existing handler. No score, loss, label, model, gate or certificate change. R71: Dispatch next analysis and current settlement immediately after durable draw, before telemetry/history. Batch receipt writes; move fallback to existing serial backfill handler; remove aggregate statistics from polling status. No score, label, target deadline or numerical rule change. R72: New target broadcasts bypass same-target tick limiter. Sole clock, DecisionGate and settlement owners retained; no reflected target or numerical change.
R70: Retry only documented request-write deadline/lock contention through the existing watchdog; keep immutable target deadline, settlement queue and fatal integrity errors.
R70: Retire prior-target cached contracts and counters with the existing new-target reset. No durable authorization, immutable record or settlement changed.
R72: Read-only same-process current anchor for resume; monotonic fetch interval. Target resolver, durable draw and model semantics unchanged.
R72: Optional draw archives use existing fair table cursor; same exact generation, archive proof, references and deletion predicates. No label or numeric change.
Recognize existing cooperative scopes as research for writer priority, including CP12 names; no numeric changes.
R68: Move existing database health read to a background worker; error rendering and lifecycle guard only. Shared DB ownership and numeric code unchanged.
R71: Fixed indexed read-only UI state keys and cached display summaries instead of per-second teacher/profile counts. Canonical writers, models and full diagnostics unchanged.
Read-only duplicate poll admission. Changed/conflicting draws keep canonical writer; identical confirmed values do not retrain or alter features.

R70: Raise capture execution slice from an admission-cost estimate to 400ms inside the existing 1200ms/preemption bound. Unchanged PIT, model scoring, transaction atomicity and future-only capture. R72: Reserved capture uses remaining enclosing deadline minus commit margin, retaining preemption/PIT/model and transaction checks. No postdraw capture or retrospective probability.

R74: Persistent bounded circular admission scan reaches candidates after terminal studies. Active reservations, calibration data and thresholds unchanged; no relabeling, synthetic evidence, certificate or REAL authority.

R70: Retire prior-target process cache entries when the sole DecisionGate starts a new issue; same-target reset behavior and all numerical functions unchanged. Future in-flight target entries preserved.
R68: Lazy-open DbStore on the existing serial background handler; encompass model status in error handling. Import and rollback retain their original owners and authorization.
R68: Use ZIP deflate level 6; existing lossless per-member SHA, byte count and CRC readback stay enforced.
R68: Reuse the owner-verified immutable snapshot hash instead of hashing the same private file twice. Resume still verifies SHA and size; no live database mutations.
R68: Clarify diagnostic versus raw backup coverage; same 96 evaluation handlers, no health or qualification thresholds changed.
R70: Include calibration model and failure metadata in a read-only report; no training or qualification side effects.

R70: Timestamp the immutable snapshot immediately after backup before hash I/O. Diagnostic freshness only. R71: Bind diagnostic timestamp before native backup pins the immutable read snapshot. No evidence or training data modified. R72: Preserve STALE_PAGE and ARCHIVE error codes in diagnostic ACK; no data or numeric change. R73: Reuse an exact generation-checked, hash-verified private retention snapshot; recover a fully reverified immutable reply after crash. FULL_REPORT still takes its own fresh complete snapshot. No statistical or mainline decision changes.
R69: Expose owner-lock check and explicit current-report pointer detach for deletion; no business state mutation.
R69: Explicit user deletion bypasses soft share grants but respects live reader locks; detached private report deletion can resume after a crash. No model/database/external-file deletion.
R69: Exact-ID removal and interactive selection retain all deferred retention requests and FIFO metadata; no learning owner changes.
R69: Durable report-only cancellation and explicit deletion under the existing sole report owner. Cancel queued exports and SAF; preserve database, model and retention state and external saved files.
R70: Recover due calibration reservations and reviewed predecessor learning runs; do not close a target with an uncommitted reservation. No evidence migration or postdraw fill.
Reserve receipt time and fair hot-lane service; same durable tasks and numerical owners.
Online labels no longer overwrite certificate-owned lifecycle state; no frozen evidence, policy or numeric changes.

R72: Cache only committed idempotent DDL by SQLite schema_version using the existing audited cache. Active bundle, certificate checks, revocation, promotion and numeric decisions unchanged; rollback/schema-change tests protect readiness.

R72: Completed DEV child may replace only its own zero-update/zero-Future parent with proxy records. Programs, pending labels and lineage retained; formal/calibration/elite/certificate protection remains. Resource retirement is not quality promotion.
R70: Serve already-admitted consecutive prospective capture before atom discovery on the same bounded owner. All model and data-role rules retained.
R72: Durable circular issue scan cannot stall behind an invalid first page. Existing exact settlement owners retained; no outcome acknowledged by scan cursor.
Only bounded lease bookkeeping after cooperative cancellation; original deadline restored; no numerical publication.

R73: Bound native SQLite at 32 MiB because full installed schema exceeds 4 MiB; buffer output without changing SCROW bytes. Reuse verified snapshot and independently reverify existing immutable receipts. Deletion/generation/predicate guards unchanged.

R73: Sole diagnostics journal owner caches exactly one immutable native backup for at most 256 uses/10 minutes. Revalidate table schema and every requested generation; stale copy refreshed; source remains read-only. Writer independently checks live generation and eligibility. No score, label, policy or certificate changes.

R73: Permit re-opening an already hash-verified private immutable copy only with an in-process unforgeable proof and unchanged file stamp; process restart hashes again. Same selected row reader, typed values and SCROW proof.

R68: Rebuild only absent or mismatched projection watermarks within the same bounded issue set. Replays original immutable events with unchanged reducer; no event fabrication, rank changes or numerical training changes.
Clear stale error detail on fetch success; diagnostic change only. R71: Read-only current-target, settlement, OOS and timestamp predicate for the UI badge; never grants authority.
R70: Allow quiet checkpoint/reclaim when critical owners are idle; retry contended attempts without a false completed timestamp. No logical deletion changes.
R74: Finite exact reviewed hash capacity becomes nine solely to preserve R65-R73 development state; unknown hashes still rejected, no transitive trust or certificate/Future migration.
96-row pages preserve pinned rows, full SHA and cursor CAS; same 64KiB and 250ms compute bounds; no atom semantic change.
R72: Buffer authenticated SCDEV input/output below digest. R71/current bytes and SHA256 identical on 5000 rows, corruption/trailing/truncation rejection and lease release checked.

R72: Read only history suffix selected by unchanged protocol; exact window equivalence tested. Stop feature computation before writer deadline, retaining immutable committed pages and same numerical inputs.
Release unchanged action lease after preemption; proposal, parent, mutation and fusion formulas unchanged.
R72: Remove repeated hot-path schema calls after migration; checkpoint proposal before insufficient remaining preparation time. Same AST, pinned source, registration and training protocol.

Use remaining compute slice across original six-slot order; no model/feature/loss changes. R72: Use available bounded 850ms lane quantum for TRAIN/EVOLVE/IMPORT with 75ms commit margin. Same durable six-slot wheel and owner implementations.
Lease-only release after preemption; remove in-memory claim only after successful durable commit.

Spend the same bounded TRAIN quantum across up to 12 persisted rotating subslots; each task owns its own transaction, input, cursor and lease. Model update, freeze and numerical kernels are unchanged.
